notable_absence.finding: 'You cannot reset the password for external domain user accounts.' is a hard, stated capability boundary on auth-domain:external with no clean object concept in the registry to attach it to (it is not a mechanism, role, or IdP - it is an administrator-initiated action). Recorded here as a finding rather than forced into a relation with a mismatched object.

cross_component_finding: Password administration (reset, force-change, temporary passwords) is stated to apply ONLY to auth-domain:local throughout this page ('Couchbase Server does not store or manage external user passwords.' / 'External users must use external authentication systems such as LDAP or SAML to change their passwords.') - the same local-only carve-out pattern recorded independently in manage-auditing.json (user-activity tracking) and manage-users-and-roles.json (account locking) elsewhere in this batch, suggesting a consistent, deliberate product boundary: every Server-side administrative control over a user's credential/session state stops at the local/external domain line.
